# Settings the server spells as a string literal and the knob table does
# not declare. One name per line; blank lines and # comments ignored.
#
# This file can only shrink. It is the inventory of what is left of the
# migration, and the test that reads it fails in both directions: a name
# spelled by hand and missing from here is new stringly configuration,
# and a name here that is now declared or no longer spelled has to be
# struck off. Declaring a setting is therefore a two-line change -- the
# table gains an entry and this file loses one.
#
# Not every name here is a setting. Some are prefixes the code builds a
# parameter name from, and some are labels passed to a function for its
# messages. Those come off the list by not being spelled by hand either,
# not by being declared.
